body:
🌍 Welcome to Unify Cobbleverse!

Dive into a modded SMP experience like no other, powered by the Cobbleverse modpack. Whether you're here to explore, battle, or build your legacy, there’s something for everyone.

🔥 What we offer:

⚔️ PvP Enabled – Fight, raid, and defend your base
🌲 Survival Multiplayer – True SMP freedom, no hand-holding
🐾 Cobblemon Experience – Catch, train, and battle Pokémon
👾 Mobs Enabled – Stay alert, danger is always around
🏗️ Build & Conquer – Form alliances or dominate solo
🚀 Active Development – Constant improvements and updates

🎮 Play your way:
Go solo, team up, or become the most feared player on the server.
Every choice matters — every action has consequences.

💬 Join the community:
Stay updated, get support, and connect with other players.

👉 Join now: Discord.gg/aSEgMQt2PG
